recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in core unless a future financial-management decision reintroduces ProcessResponse or changes the active Forms binding policy.
issue_request: FHIR-12514 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested changing the Forms value set binding from required to example in ClaimResponse, EligibilityResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, ProcessResponse, and PaymentReconciliation.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-12514-tagged implementation commit was found. The current StructureDefinition XML introduced by the 2021 source rework already contains example-strength Forms bindings for the active current/successor elements, preserving the requested result through later source migrations.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes ClaimResponse, CoverageEligibilityResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, and PaymentReconciliation. It maps EligibilityResponse forward to CoverageEligibilityResponse and PaymentReconciliation.form to PaymentReconciliation.formCode, while ProcessResponse is commented as retired/use Task. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Made no source change. ClaimResponse.formCode, CoverageEligibilityResponse.form, ExplanationOfBenefit.formCode, and PaymentReconciliation.formCode already bind http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/forms with strength example; the retired ProcessResponse spreadsheet is out of current build scope.
